vb_textbox.text: It is easy and rewarding. I only missed a few due to my cat interrupting me, just stay focused and try to remember the good gnomes. Keep your hands on the keyboard just to make it easier, unless you're like me and have a needy cat. It's pretty random which makes it fun and less serious. I was more drawn to the brighter colors and it served me well. But again, it's extremely easy and rewarding.
